newsitem.title: USA: Bitstream sees Q4 net below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Bitstream sees Q4 net below estimates.

text.p: Bitstream Inc said Monday it expects fourth-quarter revenues of $2.5-$2.6 million, about 10 percent below analysts' estimates due to the programs of certain major customers being delayed.
Bitstream also said it expects net income will be significantly lower than analysts' expectations as a result of the lower revenue and planned increases in research & development.
The First Call consensus earnings estimate is $0.08 a share for the quarter.
Bitstream reported revenues of $2.355 million in the year-ago quarter.

"While we expected stronger growth in the fourth quarter, we are pleased with the continued development of Bitstream's business and we remain positive about the directions and emerging markets such as ITV and Internet/intranet solutions that Bitstream is pursuing," President and Chairman Ray Boelig said.

Bitstream expects to release results for the quarter by the end of February. The company develops and markets software products and technologies to enhance the creation, transport, viewing and printing of electronic documents.
